name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=blit_sprite, descriptor=with_stride_loop). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects the role: the inner sprite-blit loop that copies non-zero (transparent-zero) pixels row by row, taking its destination row stride from the wPitch global. Mirrors fd2_blit_sprite_raw_with_header naming for the opaque variant.
purpose: Inner sprite-blit loop with transparent-zero handling: copies a width x height sprite from a header-prefixed source into dst_buf, skipping zero pixels, advancing the destination by the wPitch stride global per row.
logic_summary: Reads width = *(uint16*)sprite_hdr (word 0) and height = *(uint16*)(sprite_hdr+2) (word 2); src_pixels = sprite_hdr + 4 (skip 4-byte header); stride = data_fd2_graphics_glyph_blit_state.wPitch. Outer post-test do/while over rows: per row resets dst_iter = dst_buf and col_remain = width, inner post-test do/while over columns copies *src_pixels to *dst_iter only when non-zero (zero = transparent skip), advancing both src_pixels and dst_iter and decrementing col_remain. After each row dst_buf += stride and row_remain--. src_pixels runs continuously across all rows; dst resets to the row base each row. Both loops are post-test, so height 0 paints one row and width 0 wraps the column counter, matching the binary's LOOP / DEC DX;JNZ tails. void return.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Destination base linear address (row base). Register-carried in the binary (EDI), seeded by the sole caller fd2_blit_sprite_with_stride_setup; modeled as an explicit param in the portable C source. Reset to this value at the start of each row, then advanced by stride.
params.reason: Accurate descriptor for the destination buffer base; no address residue.

params.name: sprite_hdr
params.semantics: Sprite header pointer: width = word 0, height = word 2, then width*height raw pixel bytes (zero byte = transparent). Register-carried in the binary (ESI); modeled as an explicit param in the portable C source.
params.reason: Accurate descriptor for the sprite header/source pointer; no address residue. Consistent with the same param name used across the blit family in this file.

returns.semantics: No return value. Hand-written asm leaf in the binary; void in the source. (The Ghidra register-state view shows it as void __cdecl with no params because the inputs arrive in ESI/EDI.)
